reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Strengthening of HIV and Tuberculosis (“TB”) national systems of prevention, treatment, care and support in the Republic of Mongolia. - Mongolia (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Mongolia, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of Mongolia (MOH Mongolia)This program has the following goals: Reduce HIV transmission and AIDS related deaths. Provide comprehensive people-centered health services, adopting innovative methods for TB detection, screening, diagnosis and treatment and expanding the multi-sectorial collaboration.. The objectives of this program are: Increase the rate of HIV Case Detection. Strengthen HIV prevention/retain low incidence among populations at high risk. Strengthen Community and Government Health Systems and linkages between them. To increase treatment coverage of TB to 55% by 2023.. To maintain treatment success rate of TB above 90% during 2021-2023.. To provide patient-centered healthcare services comprehensively by broadening multilateral collaboration.
